classification: adversarial address selection with an exactly fixed bottleneck disk; not ordinary random

sampling_rule.reused: Only previous same-role rows satisfying the new exact bottleneck predicate
sampling_rule.fresh_sequence: fresh_start + worker_index + ordinal*worker_count; disjoint arithmetic progressions
sampling_rule.stopping_rule: Each worker stops after its fixed A/B quotas; B blocks are not hashed once its B quota is filled
